Acquisition after displacement and right-edge overlay required correction. Both terminal evade counts zero. Cannot grade continuous holds or physical thumb ergonomics.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, numbered-coil combat and deck upload gave distinct visible goals and concrete feedback. Assisted travel made progress approachable; manual guards and damage provided combat coverage. Route success alone says little about free navigation, sustained challenge or enjoyment.
